text: A later accepted change removed constructor locking because other threads cannot access the object during construction. PumpData remains an internal helper that does not lock; its caller must provide a thread-safe state. Thus the constructor can pump before publication, while public Read/Continue paths lock. This is the checked object-lifecycle contract, not a rule to omit locks from all constructors. This is static source and test-code inspection. title: Mbox constructor safety differs from caller locking after publication
